name: Open-AoE (OpenAoE-2000h)
tagline: ~2,000 h of smartphone egocentric manipulation from 500+ contributors, with MANO hands, camera trajectories and atomic actions.

annotations.coverageNote: Atomic-action segments span every video from 0.0 s to the last frame with no gaps; MANO hands valid on ~98-99% of entries (100 h audit).

narrations.note: One-sentence description per atomic action, English and Chinese

action_labels.note: verb / object / hand per segment with start and end timestamps and frames

object_boxes.note: Action-region bbox per atomic action, not an object detector box

hand_pose.note: Bilateral MANO pose, shape and root per frame in world and camera frames

camera_pose.note: Metric-scale 6-DoF cam_c2w trajectory from visual SLAM (DROID-W)

samples.caption: Open-AoE overview: smartphone capture, MANO hands, trajectories and atomic actions
